steps.title: Welcome to NUPSI-007
steps.intro: Let's take a quick tour.

steps.title: Browse Products
steps.intro: Search for a product or browse through the product catalog using this menu.

steps.title: Browse Products
steps.intro: Products are categorized by topic in the Category tab...

steps.title: Browse Products
steps.intro: ... and by source in the Satellite tab.

steps.title: Product
steps.intro: In this section, you can check the selected product: WHAT is displayed.

steps.title: Time Frame
steps.intro: In this section, you can check the selected month: WHEN the displayed product refers to.

steps.title: Time Frame
steps.intro: Use the arrows to select a month of your choosing.

steps.title: Location
steps.intro: In this section, you can check the selected place: WHERE the displayed product refers to.

steps.title: Downloads
steps.intro: Download your GeoTIFFs and GeoJSONs using this download button.

steps.title: Choose the Location
steps.intro: If you want to use a GeoJSON of your own, click on the upload button.

steps.title: Choose the Location
steps.intro: You can also draw your custom area using the polygon tool.

steps.title: Choose the Location
steps.intro: Or you can select a location using the search bar.

steps.title: Imagery
steps.intro: You can customize your map with the Layers menu...

steps.title: Statistics
steps.intro:
... Analyze data statistics...

*Remember: not all the thematic maps support the statistics feature.

steps.title: Stories
steps.intro: ... Play timelapse-style animations...

steps.title: Split view
steps.intro: ... And compare two different products over the same area through a vertical split line.

steps.title: Navigate NUTS level
steps.intro: You can select different NUTS levels by zooming in and out on the map and clicking on the area of your choosing.

steps.title: Deselct the Location
steps.intro: To deselect an area, just click again on it or select a different area.

steps.title: Login
steps.intro:
Use this button to log in and access your downloads and favorites.

*Remember: downloads and favorites list features are available only to logged-in users.

steps.title: See you soon!
steps.intro: If you want to take the tour again, just click the Info button and then select Start tour.
